opening.argument: The presentation promotes Forsage BUSD through a paid, tiered structure: registration starts at 10 BHD, payments flow to participant wallets and upline balances, and purchasing more slots is linked to larger income. It also states a 29,700 BSD earning figure for completing rounds. These are concrete inducements to pay into a recruitment structure, supporting a finding of a scam. The claim that this is not an investment plan, alongside scam-proof and opportunity assurances, must be read within that same promotion. Those assurances do not resolve the inconsistent BHD and BSD currency terms or the flagged incorrect earnings figure. The case rests on the payment and income pitch, without claiming demonstrated losses or completed payouts.
